findings.title: Embedded reply author color light value flipped from 30% to 70%
findings.body: In desktop/topic-post.scss line 291 the rule .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) and is now dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)). The light-theme value should have been preserved as 30% with dark counterpart 70% to sum to 100% like every other conversion and like the matching quote-title rule in common/base/topic-post.scss. Using 70% on a light theme lightens dark text to near-white, washing it out and making it inconsistent.

findings.title: Custom-message-length light value changed from 70% to 30%
findings.body: In mobile/modal.scss line 102 .custom-message-length was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%) and is now dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)). The light-theme branch should stay at 70% with dark branch at 30%, as done for the identical selector in desktop/modal.scss. Changing it to 30% makes the hint much darker on light themes and too light on dark themes, and diverges mobile from desktop.

findings.title: Topic-map h3 light value changed from 20% to 50%
findings.body: In mobile/topic-post.scss line 182 .topic-map h3 was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%) and is now dark-light-choose with 50%/50%. The light value should have been preserved as 20% with dark counterpart 80% to sum to 100%, matching desktop/topic-post.scss h3 which correctly uses 20%/80%. Using 50% lightens the heading far more on light themes, making it washed out and inconsistent with desktop.

findings.title: Group-member name light value changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: In desktop/user.scss line 522 .group-member-info .name was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) and is now dark-light-choose with 50%/50%. It should be 30%/70% like the original 30% value and like the matching username rules in common/base/user.scss. Changing the light branch to 50% lightens the name on existing light themes for no reason.

findings.title: Group-member name light value changed from 30% to 50% on mobile
findings.body: In mobile/user.scss line 497 .group-member-info .name was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) and is now dark-light-choose with 50%/50%. It should be 30%/70% to preserve the original light-theme color. Using 50% makes the name lighter than before on light themes and inconsistent with the intended complementary mapping.

findings.title: Missed dark-theme conversion for category badge-notification
findings.body: In common/base/_topic-list.scss line 115 .topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification still uses scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%) while the six neighboring rules for th, td, excerpt and education in the same file were converted to dark-light-choose with secondary. On a dark theme $primary is light so lightening it further yields near-white low-contrast text, leaving this one element broken and inconsistent with the rest of the file.
